meta.source: Plan_Aphaia_sanctuary-en.svg, Bibi Saint-Pol 2007, Wikimedia Commons, public domain; after Guide Joanne 1911 pl. 172-173 (after Furtwaengler 1906)
meta.frame: temple frame of src/data/resolveDimensions.ts: origin = stylobate centre, x = east (+), z = south (+); plan view, metres

pxToM.note: [x, z] = matrix @ [u, v, 1] with (u, v) SVG sheet px after all transforms

columnFit.note: rigid fit with the bar scale; the free-scale fit's rms shows how much is scale

meta.uncertaintyModel: sqrt(columnFit.rms^2 + (scale disagreement x distance from the stylobate centre)^2), per feature at its farthest point
meta.propylonStairs: Drawn as three parallel step lines on the NORTH (temple-facing, inner) side of the propylon, inside the south terrace wall; Furtwaengler's text has a stair flight rising from the south (outer side). Conflict recorded, not resolved.

features.label: Plinth beside the head of the way (unlabelled)
Small base at the temple NE corner (unlabelled)
Dwellings of priests (5th c.), with Gantry (Fiechter: priests' and attendants' quarters, not 'Amphipoleion')
features.note: key polygons are room interiors (holes of wallNetwork); the walls are the band between them

features.label: South outer peribolos (lower south retaining wall)
Short wall running south from the south terrace wall, west of the propylon
Unlabelled dashed structures on the outer terrace
Cistern
features.phaseNote: blue (7th c.) disc drawn over an orange one: older shaft, reworked in the new campaign (Furtwaengler p. 88)

features.label: Settling basin (pear-shaped, at the head of the aqueduct)
Aqueduct (water channel to the temple's north side)
Votive (sphinx) column
features.uncertain: 6th c.; that it was spared at the rebuild is only 'not impossible' (Furtwaengler p. 157)

features.label: Reconstructed (dashed) continuation of the north terrace wall toward the east peribolos, by the cave
Unlabelled 5th-c. wall traces south of the temple
Unlabelled 7th-c. foundation near the north base
Temple as drawn on the plan (registration check only, not for building)

walls.label: West terrace wall (the sheet's 'North terrace wall' label runs round this corner)
South terrace wall, west of the propylon
South terrace wall, east of the propylon to the turn
East peribolos (oblique: trapezoidal east side of the terrace)

wallNetwork.note: filled region = outer minus holes (even-odd); it is every 5th-c. wall drawn as one band, incl. terrace walls, propylon and SE-house walls
